Make a NEW small-size equipment/item icon matching the round chibi hero in reference image 1 and the soft hand-drawn broad color planes of reference image 2. Reference 1 supplies game character style, NOT the landscape. Reference 2 supplies restrained shape language, NOT UI frames or skill effects.
User direction: SIMPLE HAND-DRAWN CHIBI OBJECTS. Rounded chunky silhouette, soft dark warm charcoal/brown contour, matte flat colors with two or three large shade planes, generous opaque shapes. 32px/48px/56px readability is essential. Hand drawn cartoon, not sharp rendered mobile ARPG splash art. Avoid fine lines, micro details, bevelled shiny metal, realistic material, tiny gold filigree, saturated gem glare, glows and particles. One isolated complete physical object centered, visible body about 78–82% of canvas with generous safe transparent margins. No text, no labels, no frames, no discs, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow floating outside the object. No UI quality colors baked into the background. Preserve a real transparent alpha background.
Palette: muted blue-grey steel, warm ivory highlights, deep brown leather, muted apricot brass and subdued blue/green accent, consistent with the game hero. Never pure white bright highlights. The contour is gently rounded, large shape readable, only a few intentional interior lines. Draw the item as a coherent physical object, not a skill symbol or pictorial scene.
Reference image 3 is this batch's style anchor: same soft rounded outline, large matte color planes, low detail density and warm dark contour, but draw the requested physical resource object.
Subject: 方阵碎片. One chunky broken square slate-blue metal plate with one large inset rounded square and a single muted brass bar. A missing corner and two broad rounded stepped edges make it look like a module fragment. Matte simple physical square shard, no gears, no microtext, no gemstone glare or glowing aura.
